According to a story told by the merchant [[Jira/Legends|Jira]], a young '''pregnant woman''' was [[Death/Legends|murdered]], with the only witness being the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[Nobot/Legends|Nobot]]. Supposedly, the woman cried for help, begged for her attacker to stop, and gave a final shrill scream, all of which was recorded in Nobot's communications module. Some listeners believed Nobot to be the murderer. Jira's tale stated that the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], covered in dried [[Blood/Legends|blood]], wandered into the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] decades prior to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Nobot wandered throughout the city with the recording of the woman's death playing repeatedly.<ref name="Databank" />
